block.title: Block {{name}}?
block.body: You won't see each other's profiles or vehicles, and you can't message each other. Any follows between you end. {{name}} won't be notified.
block.failed: Blocking didn't work. Please try again.
block.reportBody: You won't see each other's profiles or vehicles, and you can't message each other. {{name}} won't be notified. Afterwards you can tell us what happened.

report.label: Report

reasonHints.illegal: For example illegal street racing, hate speech, private data or stolen photos
reasonHints.impersonation: A fake profile or someone else's identity
reasonHints.other: Breaks our community guidelines in another way

subReasonHints.street_racing: Organising or glorifying races on public roads
subReasonHints.hate_speech: Attacks on people for their origin, religion, gender or similar
subReasonHints.privacy: An address, phone number or photos of people without their consent
subReasonHints.copyright: Photos or content that belong to someone else
subReasonHints.other_illegal: Describe in the next step what isn't allowed

report.detailsHelper: What happened? A place, a time or a link helps.
report.detailsHelperIllegal: Briefly explain why you think the content is illegal. That helps us review it faster.
report.goodFaith: By sending, you confirm that your details are accurate and complete to the best of your knowledge.
report.messageNote: With your report, our team receives this message and up to {{count}} messages before and after it. Our team doesn't see the rest of the conversation.
report.sentTitle: Thank you. We'll review your report.
report.sentBody: We'll let you know once we've decided. You can check the status in your reports at any time.
report.duplicateBody: We're already reviewing your report. You can check the status in your reports at any time.
report.blockOfferBody: You won't see each other any more and can't message each other.
report.offline: You're offline. You can send once you're back online.

failure.offline: You're offline. Your report hasn't been sent yet. Try again once you're back online.
failure.rate_limited: You've sent a lot of reports in the last 24 hours. You can send more again in 24 hours at the latest. If someone is in immediate danger, call the police on 110.
failure.gone: We can't find this content any more. It may already have been removed.
failure.own: You can't report your own content.
failure.invalid: Please check your details and try again.
failure.server: Your report couldn't be sent. Please try again.

report.discardBody: What you've written won't be sent.
report.guestBody: Sign in and we'll tell you what happens with your report.
report.guestWebFormHint: Our report form also works without an account.
report.detailsRequired: Explain in at least {{min}} characters why you think the content is illegal.

reports.title: Reports & decisions
reports.intro: See what you've reported and what we've decided about your content.
reports.emptyMineBody: If something seems wrong, tap “Report” on the content.
reports.emptyAboutBody: There are no decisions about your content.
reports.offlineBody: We'll load your reports once you're back online.
reports.offlineBanner: Offline – this may not be up to date.
reports.soonBody: Soon you'll see here what you've reported and what we've decided.

outcome.remove_content: We removed “{{label}}”. Others can no longer see it.
outcome.restrictMessaging: You can't send messages for now.
outcome.restrictPublishing: You can't publish or edit anything for now.
outcome.restrictPublishingUntil: You can't publish or edit anything until {{until}}.
outcome.suspend: Your account is suspended. Others can no longer see your profile or vehicles.
outcome.suspendUntil: Your account is suspended until {{until}}. Others can't see your profile or vehicles until then.
outcome.restrict: We restricted features of your account.
outcome.reverseAccount: We lifted the measure on your account. You can use it as before.
outcome.reverseContent: We lifted the earlier decision. “{{label}}” is visible to everyone again.

reporterOutcome.no_action: We reviewed “{{label}}” and found no breach of our rules or the law. The content stays visible.
reporterOutcome.remove_content: We reviewed “{{label}}” and removed it. Thank you for your report.
reporterOutcome.measures: We reviewed “{{label}}” and took action. Thank you for your report.
reporterOutcome.reversed: We lifted an earlier measure concerning “{{label}}”.

decision.reporterNote: Out of respect for everyone involved, we don't share details about the other member.
decision.appealOpen: You can appeal until {{date}}. Another person on our team will review it and tell you the result.
decision.appealWaiting: You can appeal for 6 months. The period starts once we've notified you.
decision.appealPending: We received your appeal of {{date}}. Another person on our team is reviewing it.
decision.appealUpheld: We reviewed your appeal and confirmed the decision on {{date}}.
decision.appealReversed: We reviewed your appeal and reversed the decision on {{date}}.
decision.disputeBody: You can turn to a certified out-of-court dispute settlement body under Art. 21 DSA.
decision.courtBody: You can also have the decision reviewed by a court at any time.
decision.notFoundBody: The link may be old, or it belongs to another account.
decision.offlineBody: We'll load the decision once you're back online.
decision.restricted: Your account is restricted. You can still view decisions and appeal.
decision.detectionYes: The content was detected by automated means.
decision.detectionNo: The content was detected without automated means, for example through a report.
decision.decisionAutomated: The decision was taken by automated means.
decision.decisionHuman: A person on our team made the decision, not an automated system.

scope.contentOpen: Applies to this content across SPEED CLUB. It stays removed unless an appeal succeeds.
scope.accountOpen: Applies to your account and has no end date.

decision.reverseNote: There is nothing more you need to do. The earlier decision no longer applies, so there is nothing to appeal here.
decision.detectionStaff: We reviewed this ourselves, without automated means.
decision.reverseGround: We reviewed the earlier decision again. It doesn’t hold up as it was, so everything is back to how it was before the measure.

restrictedNow.suspended: Your account is suspended. You can still view decisions and appeal.
restrictedNow.publishing: One restriction still applies to your account: publishing is blocked. You can still view decisions and appeal.
restrictedNow.messaging: One restriction still applies to your account: writing messages is blocked. You can still view decisions and appeal.
restrictedNow.both: Restrictions still apply to your account: publishing and writing messages are blocked. You can still view decisions and appeal.

appeal.title: Appeal
appeal.body: Tell us why you think the decision is wrong. Another person on our team will review your appeal.
appeal.label: Your reasons
appeal.sentBody: We'll let you know by notification and email once we've decided.

failure.offline: You're offline. Your appeal hasn't been sent yet. Try again once you're back online.
failure.rate_limited: Too many attempts in a short time. Try again in a few minutes.
failure.duplicate: There's already an appeal for this decision.
failure.server: Your appeal couldn't be sent. Please try again.

appeal.discardBody: What you've written won't be sent.

guest.title: Sign in
guest.body: You can see your reports and decisions with your account.
